card.name: Single dose or split doses
card.fires_on: The word "or" right after "in one day" or "a single dose", where the text goes on to offer splitting the amount into divided doses. Also "mg" or "question" where a split or divide instruction continues.

modes.label: Single or divided dose
modes.description: "or" after "single dose" or "in one day", just before "divided doses" or "split over" days.
modes.example: (given in one day<< or>> split over two consecutive days)

modes.label: Dividing larger amounts
modes.description: Words inside instructions to divide or split an amount or item across parts.
modes.example: Divide doses of more than 150<< mg>>

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like "spread", "spreading" and "across", meaning the amount is spread over several parts.
card.plain: It fires when a label says a dose can be given at once or split up into several parts.
